- 447a19e4 "Integrate reviewed PHRF decoder repair and bounded evidence": 0/3. Gaussian and LWU admitted 0.0%, all accuracy statistics NaN, compact route accepted 0.0% (fallbacks=1, candidates=1.00, terminal-jets=1.00).
- fa6bd6a9 (local main snapshot) and the sync merge: identical 0/3.
The commit message already states "PHRF-21 gates remain unmet". Hosted CI run 37091088293 shows the same failure (ConditionMilestoneSuite.scala:353/366/429).
Consequence, user decision 2026-10-03: the sync lands local main only up to c05a0811. The PHRF integration (447a19e4), its follow-ups e6eb79d0 and d727969c, and the later fa6bd6a9 (design-review graphics) stay on local main for the next sync, after these gates pass.
